content.title: Elliott pushes for former Ralph Lauren exec. as new Lululemon CEO
content.description:
As Lululemon (LULU) searches for a new CEO, Elliott Management has taken a $1 billion stake in the athleisure company. The activist investor is pushing for Jane Nielsen, a former Ralph Lauren (RL) executive, to be considered, sources told Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi.

Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma, alongside Slatestone Wealth chief market strategist Kenny Polcari, joins Opening Bid to talk about the CEO shake-up.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
